 Memory: 8GB DDR4 ‎3200 MHz
 Hard Drive: 128GB PCIe SSD
 Optical Drive: No

 Audio: Stereo speakers with HD Audio support
 Microphone: Integrated dual array digital microphones with AI noise reduction and microphone mute key
 Keyboard: Full-size keyboard with Numeric Keypad
 Touchpad: Precision touchpad with multi-touch gesture support
 Built-in HD Webcam: HP True Vision 720p HD camera with privacy shutter
 Certification: ENERGY STAR certified, EPEAT Gold registered
 Ports:

2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A
 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C
 1 x HDMI 1.4b
 1 x Headphone/microphone combo

Battery: Up to 10.25h battery life
 Color: Moonlight Blue
 Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 14.17 x 9.29 x 0.73
 Weight: 3.53 lbs

items.label: Smooth Multitasking with Intel Core i3 Processor
items.value: Powered by the latest Intel Core i3-N305 8-core, 8-thread processor with up to 3.8GHz max turbo frequency, this laptop delivers smooth, responsive performance for everyday tasks — perfect for work, study, and online browsing.

items.label: Vibrant 15.6" Full HD Touchscreen Display
items.value: Enjoy crisp visuals and interactive control on a 15.6-inch Full HD (1920×1080) IPS touchscreen. The anti-glare BrightView panel and micro-edge design provide wide viewing angles and immersive clarity for streaming and productivity.

items.label: Smart Productivity with Windows 11 and AI Copilot
items.value: Pre-installed Windows 11 with Microsoft Copilot helps you work smarter — generate summaries, organize tasks, and access intelligent suggestions directly from your desktop. Seamlessly integrated for study, creativity, and daily planning.

items.label: Enhanced Audio, Camera & Connectivity
items.value: Experience clear video calls with the HP True Vision 720p HD camera featuring a privacy shutter and dual array microphones with AI noise reduction. Stay connected with fast Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 for reliable wireless performance.

items.label: Portable Design with Full-Size Keyboard & Long Battery Life
items.value: Type comfortably on the full-size keyboard with numeric keypad and work anywhere with up to 10.25 hours of battery life. The lightweight 3.53 lb design makes it easy to carry, ideal for home, school, or travel.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Numeric Keypad

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, keyboards, mice, and other devices with USB, HDMI, or wireless connectivity
